components.name: PresenceDot
components.doc: A presence mark that morphs between statuses: the color crossfades while a hole opens for away and a bar slides in for busy.

types.name: UserMenuProps
types.doc: The account menu behind a person's photo in an app's top bar. It holds a compact identity header, a short group of account destinations, an inline theme switch, and sign out. On screens narrower than 640px it opens as a bottom sheet instead. Theme and status choices keep the menu open; everything else closes it and returns focus to the trigger. When `onSignOut` returns a promise, the item shows its progress and the menu closes once it settles.

members.name: status
members.doc: Presence status. Passing `status` or `onStatusChange` shows the presence dot and an inline status switch.

members.name: onThemeChange
members.doc: Reports the choice. Applying it to the page is up to the app.

members.name: showTheme
members.doc: Shows the inline light, dark, and system switch.

members.name: items
members.doc: Account destinations with optional shortcut hints, such as ["⌘", ","]. Keep it to three or four.

members.name: showName
members.doc: Shows the name and a chevron beside the avatar from 640px up.

members.name: portal
members.doc: Renders the desktop panel in a portal on the body. Pass false to keep it inside the trigger's wrapper.

members.name: ref
members.doc: The trigger button, for returning focus after the menu is swapped out.
